seo.title: About – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Runner since 2020, triathlete since 2021, pro from 2027. I'm from the Munich area and I love long-distance racing.

title: About me
lead: I've been running since 2020 and doing triathlon since 2021. From 2027 I'm racing as a professional.
body:
It all started in 2020 with running. A year later swimming and cycling came along, and triathlon hasn't let go of me since.

I'm from the Munich area. For the last few years I lived in Passau for my studies. My home, Bavaria, means a lot to me.

## My favourite distance

What excites me most is long-distance racing. I like to race these with nothing held back. My best races so far were my two starts at Challenge Roth in 2025 and 2026.

## Why I coach

I'm very interested in sports science, but above all I'm interested in people. Finding the right approach for each person gives me a lot of joy. To me, there is no plan that fits everyone.
